`ext` is computed from two base columns, with the CTE levels collapsed into one statement (query11111.sql:23). Both are pre-aggregation value edges with transform `derived`:
- `lgx.shipment_line.shipped_qty`
- `lgx.shipment_line.unit_selling_price`

The upstream search went 10 hops deep and found nothing beyond these two columns. No boundaries or refusals apply.

Other columns only filter the result rows. They are not part of the value of `ext`. They are `shipment_header.is_deleted`, `shipment_id`, `status_code` and `updated_at`, plus `shipment_line.line_status`, `promise_date`, `shipped_qty` and `unit_selling_price`.

It comes from crm.customer, not crm.contact. The only value source is crm.customer.customer_name, copied unchanged (identity, pre-aggregation) at pasted/query11111.sql:23. No lineage was found from crm.contact into this column. No boundaries or refusals apply.

primary_email takes its value from crm.contact.email (identity, pre-aggregation, line 23). crm.contact.is_primary is a conditional value source on the same line, so it decides which contact's email comes through. The graph has no INFLUENCES edges into this column. There are no boundaries or refusals on the lineage. The result also has table-level filters from lgx.shipment_header and lgx.shipment_line; they limit rows and are not cited.

carrier_name (pasted/query11111.sql:23) is fed by lgx.carrier.carrier_name (identity, the name copied unchanged). What picks the carrier: lgx.carrier.carrier_code, lgx.shipment_header.carrier_code and lgx.shipment_header.shipment_id feed it as conditional value sources (pre-aggregation). The graph does not show the exact CASE/COALESCE logic or join keys (key equalities give no edge). Table-level filters on the result (shipment_header.is_deleted, shipment_id, status_code, updated_at; shipment_line.line_status, promise_date, shipped_qty, unit_selling_price) bound which rows appear but do not feed this column. No boundaries or refusals on this lineage.

- lgx.shipment_header: updated_at, is_deleted, shipment_id, status_code
